info.title: WordSoHard Word Game Dictionary API
info.summary: Definition, Scrabble validity, and tile score for any word in one call.
info.description: A free, keyless, CORS-enabled dictionary API built for word games. Each lookup returns an original WordSoHard definition plus word-game data: whether the word is playable in the WordSoHard Word List (about 257,000 words), its base Scrabble tile score, and whether it is a bingo (7+ tiles). Free for personal and commercial use with attribution to wordsohard.com. Fair use: roughly 60 requests per minute per IP.

license.name: Free to use with attribution to wordsohard.com

externalDocs.description: Human-readable docs, live try-it box, and use-case examples

get.description: Returns the definition, Scrabble validity, and base tile score for a word. Words without a definition return HTTP 200 with found set to false, so callers never need to handle a 404. The scrabble object is always present.

parameters.name: word
parameters.description: The word to look up, 2-30 letters. Input is lowercased and stripped of anything outside a-z.

200.description: Lookup result. Check found to see whether a definition exists.

Cache-Control.description: Found words are cacheable for a day in the browser; misses for five minutes.

definitions.definition: The faculty of making fortunate discoveries by accident or luck.

value.license: Free to use with attribution to wordsohard.com

notFound.summary: A word we do not have

value.license: Free to use with attribution to wordsohard.com

400.description: The word is shorter than 2 or longer than 30 letters after normalization.

word.description: The normalized word that was looked up.

found.description: Whether a definition exists for this word.

lemma.description: Base form, when the word is an inflection (for example, cats -> cat).

partOfSpeech.description: Part of speech of the primary sense.

definitions.description: One entry per sense. Empty when found is false.

attribution.description: Credit line to display next to the definitions.

register.description: Usage label such as informal, archaic, or offensive, when one applies.

valid.description: Whether the word is playable in the WordSoHard Word List.

score.description: Base Scrabble tile score, without premium squares.

bingo.description: True if the word uses 7 or more tiles.
